title: aria-cross-reviewer agent emits non-canonical response envelope; kernel validator rejects status='ok'
resolved_by: ARIA-V10.4 Phase 3.H.6 (class-level Tier-1 fix + Tier-3 invariant)

agent_envelope_drift_observed.details_cross_review_shape: emitted legacy V7 {reviews:[]} instead of canonical {risks:[]}
agent_envelope_drift_observed.satisfaction_matrix_field_names: agent emitted both canonical ({id, verdict}) and non-canonical ({constraint_id, satisfied:bool}) field names

structural_root_cause.missing_ssot_reference: aria-cross-reviewer.md did NOT reference @.claude/knowledge/layer-2-aria-canonical-envelope.md (the shared SSoT). aria-primary-planner.md and aria-challenger-planner.md both already referenced it. The cross-reviewer's Output envelope section carried an inline non-canonical schema sketch that diverged from the kernel contract in three independent ways.
structural_root_cause.knowledge_ssot_omission: The canonical envelope SSoT's introduction (line 5-6) only listed aria-primary-planner and aria-challenger-planner as referring agents — aria-cross-reviewer was omitted, so a future agent-contract author had no signal that the SSoT applied to the cross-reviewer too.
structural_root_cause.tier_1_anchor: Same architectural class as Plan V8.1 Bug 4 (challenger envelope schema drift) — when an agent prompt does not reference the canonical envelope SSoT, the Opus model improvises a shape from the prompt's inline sketch alone, and any sketch divergence becomes a kernel-validator rejection.

tier_1_architectural_fix.scope: class-level — addresses every agent prompt that may diverge from canonical envelope, not just cross-reviewer
files_changed: .claude/agents/aria-cross-reviewer.md (Output envelope section replaced with SSoT reference + 3 kernel-contract anchors)
.claude/knowledge/layer-2-aria-canonical-envelope.md (line 5-6 broadened reference list to include aria-cross-reviewer)
aria-kernel/tests/invariants/v10/test_phase_v10_4_phase_3_h_6_cross_reviewer_ssot.py (Tier-3 invariant — 4 tests catch the drift class structurally)
tier_1_architectural_fix.tier_rationale: Tier-1 (make impossible): the cross-reviewer prompt now points at the canonical SSoT, so the Opus model cannot improvise a divergent shape — the SSoT IS the schema. Tier-3 (make detectable): the new invariant test (4 cases) catches the drift class regression at CI time. The invariant scans every aria-*.md prompt for non-canonical status values, so the same bug cannot recur in any agent prompt going forward.

kernel_code_changes: NONE — kernel validators were already correct. Bug was entirely in agent prompt + knowledge SSoT contract drift.

expected_impact_on_endurance.before_fix: every cycle that reaches CROSS_REVIEW_REQUESTED state hits the same status='ok' rejection → cross_review_poll_timeout at 600s → convergence_blocked. 20-cycle endurance budget burned on a single bug class.
expected_impact_on_endurance.after_fix: next cross_review subprocess (hot-reload picks up new prompt) emits canonical envelope → kernel accepts → CROSS_REVIEWED transition → cycle proceeds to either CONVERGED or HUMAN_REQUIRED (real verdict). V10.4 architectural closure (cross_review_recorded event) becomes reachable.
